summary: Short kerb at a busy junction, signed no stopping, steep, townhouses 15 m away.
reasons: No Stopping sign beside the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Terraces and a house 15-22 m away, apartments 19 m; busy suburban corner with no screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb stretch of 14 m beside a through road; a van would sit in or near the junction mouth.
drivers.traffic: Junction of two through streets with steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, but signs here restrict parking and stopping.

flags: Signs: No Parking Specified Times (twice) and No Stopping Any Time
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the east verge give partial shade in the morning.

best_section.where: East kerb of York Street just south of the junction corner
